name: Nose & taste

overlay.caption: tongue: a few basic tastes · nose: smells from the back of the mouth add everything else

does: Shows the flavour you notice falling as the nose gets more blocked
Shows the tongue's basic tastes — sweet, salty, sour, bitter, savory — staying the same
Shows that most of what we call flavour depends on smell
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Include texture, temperature or spiciness, which also shape flavour
Say anything about colds or how to clear a stuffy nose
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: If you lose your sense of smell or taste for a long time without a stuffy nose, tell an adult.

sources: NIH NIDCD: Smell and taste (student pages)
